build_TransformerMemNetModel: build a TransformerMemNetModel with opt and dictionary to encode context, memories, and candidates
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass on token IDs, memories, and candidates to get context and candidate embeddings
encode_candidates: encode candidate token IDs into vector representations using the candidate encoder
encode_context_memory: encode context tokens and memories together with attention to get weighted context representations
build_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder for context or candidate encoding with shared embeddings and reduction type
